# Each call to `serde_json::from_*` in a client source file that can send an HTTP request.
#
# A Hub reply is read with `agentscm::hub::reply`, never with `serde_json`: the types carry the
# strictness the Hub applies to requests, and one new field in a reply would then break every
# installed client. The calls listed here read something else, named in the comment above each
# file's calls.
#
# `client_code_reads_hub_replies_only_through_the_lenient_reader` (tests/integration/
# client_replies.rs) finds every such call outside each file's test module and fails on a call
# not listed here, or a listed call that is gone. Each line is one call: the path, then the
# trimmed source line the call is on (listed once per call on that line). There is no count to
# keep, so changes that add or remove different calls do not collide.

# src/agent_task_cli.rs: the caller's task JSON file
src/agent_task_cli.rs Ok(serde_json::from_slice(&bytes)?)

# src/change_capture_client.rs: the capture config file, the recipe file, the agent's settings file as untyped JSON
src/change_capture_client.rs let mut root: Value = serde_json::from_str(&existing)
src/change_capture_client.rs serde_json::from_str(&text).map_err(|_| invalid("change capture config is not valid"))?;
src/change_capture_client.rs serde_json::from_str(&text).map_err(|_| invalid("configured recipe file is not valid"))?;

# src/client_cli/computer.rs: the local attention file as untyped JSON
src/client_cli/computer.rs let value: Value = serde_json::from_str(&text).ok()?;

# src/client_config.rs: connections.json
src/client_config.rs serde_json::from_str(text).map_err(|_| invalid("connections.json is not valid"))?;

# src/client_mcp.rs: JSON-RPC messages as untyped JSON; a tool call is routed and completed, the rest pass unchanged
src/client_mcp.rs let message = serde_json::from_slice(&line)?;
src/client_mcp.rs let message = serde_json::from_slice::<Value>(&line).ok();
src/client_mcp.rs let message: Value = match serde_json::from_slice(&line) {
